segments.name: CEA equipment
segments.description: Distributes and manufactures hydroponic and controlled environment agriculture equipment and supplies for growers, mainly in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: The business is organized as one operating segment managed on a consolidated basis, and one reportable segment, which is the distribution and manufacture of CEA equipment and supplies.

revenueModel.text: Wholesale customers such as specialty hydroponic retailers, resellers and garden centers pay for CEA equipment and supplies.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers include specialty hydroponic retailers, commercial resellers and greenhouse builders, garden centers, hardware stores, and e-commerce retailers.
